player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone Player {player_id}. Yaa ngone di tànk Memory Game.
Waxadale waa ngone moo gënaa ñaar-ñaar kart yi ci bànqaas bi, tey waa sa ñaaw.
Ci tànk waa, ndawloo ñaar kart ngir jébbaloo ci ñoom, ndawloo limu row ak column yi ci ñaar kart yi ci màndaŋa '[0 1 1 0]', nde ñaar kart yi ci row 0 ak column 1, ak ñaar kart yi ci row 1 ak column 0.
Bu ñaar kart yi daje, waa am na ñett ak kart yi des ci kaw. Bu ñu dul daje, kart yi dañu ci suuf, màndaŋa '.'.
Tànk bi jeex na bu ñaar-ñaar yi daje.

Bànqaas bi Tànk bi ci suŋu:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jëf ju amul solo. Njiitu {player_id} tontuwul ak benn yoon bu am solo ci ay tëriin yu ràkk yi nekk ciy kuréet-réew mi .
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Jëf ju amul solo. Njiit {player_id} tànn na fi nekk ci lu dul àdduna bi .
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Jëf ju amul solo. Njiit {player_id} tànn na benn kaar gi ñaari yoon.
invalid_move.already_matched: Jëf ju amul solo. Njiitu {player_id} tànn na benn walla ñaari kaar yi ñu séddale woon ba noppi.

game_message.cards_match: Ñaar kart yi Player {player_id} ndawloo ci ñoom ci posisyon yi [{r1} {c1}] ak [{r2} {c2}] daje!
game_message.cards_no_match: Ñaar kart yi Player {player_id} ndawloo ci ñoom dul daje. Kart yi ci posisyon yi [{r1} {c1}] ak [{r2} {c2}] ñoo {pos1} ak {pos2} ci màndaŋa.

outcome.draw: Ñaari jëfandikukat yi mat nañu benn limug kaar yu ñu séddale.
outcome.win: Jëfandikukat bi {winner_id} moo ci jël ndam!
outcome.turn_limit: Limite bi ci turn bi dafa jeggi. Xew xew dafa jeex. Joueur 0 ak {score_0} poin, Joueur 1 ak {score_1} poin.
